A '''sky-scan sensor''' was a type of [[Sensor/Legends|sensor]] that was capable of detecting incoming intruders. [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] placed a sky-scan sensor on a ridge above the ''[[Millennium Falcon/Legends|Millennium Falcon]]'' when it was landed in a valley on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ammuud/Legends|Ammuud]] to spot attackers approaching the ship that the vessel's sensors were unable to detect.<ref name="EGTAS" />
